newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal prepares bill to ban cloning humans.
newsitem.headline: Portugal prepares bill to ban cloning humans.

text.p: Portugal's government is preparing a bill to ban the cloning of humans after a British breakthrough in cloning an adult sheep, Health Minister Maria de Belem Roseira said on Friday.
Portugal presently has no laws on cloning. Belem, talking to Channel One state television, did not say when the bill would be presented to parliament.

The cloning by scientists in Scotland of Dolly the sheep, the first animal to be successfully cloned from an adult cell, has spread alarm worldwide about the possibility that the same technique could be extended to humans.
